definition: The Lifetime of Experiences Questionnaire (LEQ) is a self-report measure used to capture experiences across different stages of life. In this study, it was used to record whether people had played a musical instrument in early, middle, and late life.

reasons: The packet supports the LEQ as a self-report measure for lifetime musical activity, specifically participation in playing a musical instrument across early, middle, and late life stages; it does not support the broader claim that it captures “experiences across different stages of life” in general.
The definition should not generalize the instrument beyond the study context provided in the packet.

The packet does not support the general description that LEQ is used “to capture experiences across different stages of life”; it only states that lifetime musical activity was operationalized using LEQ with early, middle, and late life stages.

The packet provides evidence for LEQ’s role in this study (self-reported musical instrument playing across early, middle, late life), but does not support broader claims about what kinds of “experiences” the questionnaire captures beyond musical activity in this context.
